newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj tender details due Monday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj tender details due Monday.

text.p: Tender details for the privatization of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj are due to be published Monday, Brazilian newspapers reported Sunday.

The Jornal do Brasil newspaper said even the World Bank had expressed an interest in snapping up a share of Banerj when it goes on the auction block December 17, the first of Brazil's state banks to be privatized.
Banerj has been run by private bank Bozano Simonsen since last January, in preparation for its privatization.
Jornal do Brasil said the bank's minimum price will be 480.0 million reais, of which 436.69 million reais are for the bank and the rest for its insurance division.
It added that Rio de Janeiro state was selling its full 99.97 percent share of Banerj's capital and would assume all the bank's debt, estimated at 2.0 billion reais.
Officials in Rio were not available to confirm the reports.
